DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced interstitial nephritis (likely from amoxicillin or cephalexin).

The urinalysis showing eosinophilic cells confirms an allergic reaction in the kidneys, and the negative bacterial culture rules out a typical UTI. Your recent rash and flank pain are classic signs of this condition.
